claims.statement: Within the Projectiology framework, estado vibracional denotes a vibration condition that may be perceptible to the practitioner and is used in projection techniques.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
Vieira, Projeciologia
claims.notes: Only the reported vibration phenomenology and procedural role are eligible for NC alignment.

claims.statement: The framework explains the vibrational state as acceleration of the energossoma and psicossoma in relation to the physical body, potentially producing projection.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
claims.notes: Source-framework mechanism; excluded from Nova ontology and from independent scientific assertions.

claims.statement: Projectiology uses decolagem for the transition in which the projected consciousness/psychosome is described as leaving ordinary coincidence with the physical body.
source_basis: IIPC — Projeciologia overview
IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
Vieira, Projeciologia
claims.notes: The transition structure is eligible for comparison; the psychosome ontology is not.

claims.statement: The Projectiology framework interprets takeoff as the psychosome carrying consciousness away from the physical-body coincidence state.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
claims.notes: Retained solely as Vieira/IIPC source framing.

claims.statement: The Projectiology/Conscientiology framework defines psicossoma as an emotional or extraphysical vehicle through which consciousness is said to manifest during many lucid projections.
source_basis: IIPC — Projeciologia / Veículos de Manifestação
Vieira, Projeciologia
claims.notes: Needed to understand Vieira terminology; not an NC ontology candidate.

claims.statement: The framework treats the psicossoma as an objectively existing vehicle of consciousness capable of operating outside the physical body.
source_basis: IIPC — Projeciologia / Veículos de Manifestação
IIPC — Waldo Vieira e a Conscienciologia
claims.notes: Crosswalk may compare body-perception phenomenology without accepting this ontological claim.

claims.statement: IIPC describes semiprojection as a partial projection/exteriorization, with examples involving only a hand, arm, leg or other portion while the rest remains in coincidence.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção Consciente Fragmentada
claims.notes: Strong operational comparison candidate for NC Sortie partielle.

claims.statement: The framework explains semiprojection as partial exteriorization of the psychosome.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção Consciente Fragmentada

claims.statement: Projectiology distinguishes semiconscious projection from semiprojection and characterizes it by discontinuity or partial/disordered lucidity during the projected experience.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção Consciente Fragmentada
IIPC educational material derived from Vieira
claims.notes: The framework literature also places this near lucid-dream language, while NC separates lucidity degree from dream-state category.

claims.statement: Vieira defines projective catalepsy as a temporary psychophysical condition in which a lucid person cannot move the physical body, with slowed respiration and motor/sensory dissociation.
source_basis: Vieira, Projeciologia — Catalepsia Projetiva
IIPC — Fenômenos Parapsíquicos
claims.notes: Phenomenological description is comparable to sleep paralysis; framework causation is separate.

claims.statement: IIPC/Projectiology explains projective catalepsy through incomplete coincidence or communication among framework-defined vehicles and the physical body.
source_basis: IIPC — Fenômenos Parapsíquicos
IIPC educational module on Catalepsia Projetiva
claims.notes: Not imported into the NC phenomenon model.

claims.statement: IIPC describes ballonnement as a sensation of bodily swelling or expansion that may occur before or around the framework's takeoff phase.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
claims.notes: No direct canonical NC node currently captures this specific embodiment sensation.

claims.statement: The framework attributes ballonnement to exteriorization of the psychosome, often with greater energossoma ballast.
source_basis: IIPC — Técnica da Projeção da Consciência pelo Estado Vibracional
